description: Archive one session in the Bridge's own overlay: it is hidden from list_catalog (unless include_archived) and the dashboard and refuses send_prompt (FORBIDDEN, session_archived). It makes no native write and never deletes anything. Refused unless the session is idle, has no pending permission and no running child, under a lifecycle root with the archive mode. Reversible with unarchive_session. Capped by archive_per_hour. Unavailable under BRIDGE_READ_ONLY.
name: archive_session

description: Interrupt the Bridge execution that holds the session's guard, wait until it settled, then archive the session in the overlay. A failed or uncertain interrupt leaves the session un-archived. Same cap and audit as archive_session. Unavailable under BRIDGE_READ_ONLY.
name: close_session

description: Create a new OpenCode session in a directory under a configured lifecycle root (the root itself unless max_depth allows a subdirectory). It never creates directories, never accepts a prompt, permission, agent or model, makes exactly one native write per accepted request and never retries it: an unknown outcome is UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and the session must be found through the catalog. Unavailable under BRIDGE_READ_ONLY.
name: create_session

description: Find authorized sessions by repository, workspace or parent; sorted by session ID; limit 1–200, offset 0–1000
name: find_sessions

description: Read correlated execution results and verification evidence; prefer this over copying whole session transcripts
name: get_execution_result

description: Inspect native agents and API declarations for an authorized session. Prefer native subagents for large exploration/review when permitted; no Claude Chat spawning API is assumed.
name: get_harness_capabilities

description: Inspect a visible repository identity; identity never grants access
name: get_repository

description: Inspect an explicit authorized session and its repository/workspace context
name: get_session

description: Read-only catalog of the sessions the ACL authorizes, with an instance-qualified session_ref, optional exact-match filters (root, state, updated_since, created_by_bridge, harness_name), sorted by session ID; limit 1-200, offset 0-1000. Aggregates describe the returned page only. Overlay-archived sessions are hidden unless include_archived is true. Claude Code sessions are omitted until their adapter is wired.
name: list_catalog

description: List repositories visible through authorized existing sessions (maximum 1000 ACL entries)
name: list_repositories

description: List candidate sessions from the static ACL; select by repository/workspace, parent and task relevance before reading history
name: list_sessions

description: Prefer limit 20–50 (maximum 200). Inspect timestamps: pages preserve native order, not a guaranteed latest window. Pass opaque next_cursor as before for older continuation on installed OpenCode. Fetch more only as needed; omit pagination for legacy output.
name: read_session_history

description: Answer one pending native permission request of an explicit waiting execution with reject. The decision is made by the Chat model, or by a human only if claude.ai's per-call approval is configured for this tool: the server cannot verify which (decided_by=chat_client, human_verified=false). reject only in this mode (allow_once is refused, never always); sends no message; makes one native write after an audit record and never retries it: an unknown outcome is UNKNOWN_OUTCOME with an attempt_id, and one explicit superseding reject may quote it in supersedes. Configure per-call approval for this tool. Unavailable under BRIDGE_READ_ONLY.
name: reply_permission

description: Submit once to the explicitly selected existing session ID; discovery does not grant write access
name: send_prompt

description: Restore the visibility of an overlay-archived session (it restores nothing else). Same preconditions, cap and audit as archive_session. Unavailable under BRIDGE_READ_ONLY.
name: unarchive_session
